description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

When a Signal-declared effect of yours fails, halve the force damage you take from that failure, rounding down. You can apply only one Signal failure mitigation to a given failure: if you use Absorb the Cost on it, this feat does not apply to that failure. The Drift point still lands, every time, and nothing in this feat touches it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Halve force damage from a Signal failure (unless Absorb the Cost used). A real number ('halve') modifying the unbuildable Signal/Static mechanic. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`).
